summary: Deliverables created: (1) Underwriting workbook with live formulas and inputs/outputs (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx) including sensitivity and source register; (2) Concise investment/sales OM PDF (artifacts/memorandum-v1.pdf). As of 2026-08-31, 7 of 8 suites are occupied (87.5% by units and ~87.5% by area). Underwritten EGI $1.335MM; NOI before reserves $0.903MM; NCF after reserves $0.900MM. Capitalized at 6.25% implies $14.44MM value. Loan sizing at the 7.00% floor with 30-year amortization yields maximum proceeds $9.021MM, DSCR-constrained; after 1% origination, $45k closing and $7.80MM payoff, net cash out is about $1.085MM. No near-term rollover; policy insurance limit is $2.0MM; capital costs are not embedded in opex; no unsigned rent changes or free rent affect Suite 001. Sizing floor binds. All figures trace to cited packet sources and the modeling assumptions in underwriting-instructions.pdf.
